narr: Thunderstorms over the higher terrain of northern Arizona pushed southwest into the lower deserts during the evening of the 18th. These thunderstorms continued in a favorable environment characterized by abundant moisture (PWATs around 1.8-1.9) and high instability (MUCAPE around 2,000 J/kg). As these thunderstorms moved through the Lower Colorado River Valley area near Blythe, they produced damaging winds and flash flooding. No injuries were reported.
ev: CHP reported that U.S. 95 north of Blythe was closed due to flooding. There were also reports of vehicles washed off the roadway. No injuries were reported.
